entities.name: Ouramos
entities.description: Dryad domain of overgrown ruins in the eastern Deepwood on Mercadia, containing the Henge of Ramos.

entities.name: Weatherlight crew
entities.description: Nine crew who traveled through Ouramos.

entities.name: Ilcaster
entities.description: Crew member killed by dryad vines.

entities.name: Tallakaster
entities.description: Crew member killed by dryad vines.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Weatherlight captain who offered subservience to the dryads.

entities.name: Dryads
entities.description: Forest dryads of Ouramos led by a chieftain.

entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: Dragon engine whose origin the dryads told.

entities.name: Takara
entities.description: Really Volrath in disguise, who stole the gems.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Disguised as Takara, stole the powerstones.

events.summary: A vine dryad attack drove back the Weatherlight crew, killing Ilcaster and Tallakaster.
events.quote: Both Ilcaster and Tallakaster were killed in this manner

events.summary: Gerrard offered the dryads subservience and bonded telepathically with their chieftain, learning Ramos's origin.
events.quote: Gerrard Capashen offered the dryads subservience

events.summary: Aided by the dryads, the crew lit the powerstones with the conscience of the Deepwood.
events.quote: they collected the conscience of the Deepwood to light the powerstones

events.summary: Takara, really Volrath in disguise, stole the gems and escaped to Mercadia City.
events.quote: Takara (really Volrath in disguise) had stolen the gems

relations.quote: Telepathically bonding with the chieftain of the dryads
